userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: The read's overall or plate confidence is below the threshold the policy sets for acting without review.
The engine reported no confidence for the plate, so its quality cannot be judged automatically.
The applicable law or operator policy requires a person to check every read of this kind (for example, before any enforcement use), whatever its confidence.
Reads of the same passage (one captureGroup) disagree on the plate, country, or state/province.
